title: Canonical internal scalar towers and normalized locally closed support comparisons
statement: For condensed commutative coefficient rings $A,B$ [sk-def-sfb-condensed-ring] and a ring-object map $c:A\to B$, use the pulled-back coefficients on small pro-etale sites [sk-def-sfb-pulled-back-coefficients], [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site]. Define the ordinary unbounded internal-module derived categories and their actual K-flat scalar functor, exact restriction and scalar adjunction [sk-def-sfb-module-objects], [sk-def-sfb-derived-categories], [sk-def-sfb-derived-extension-of-scalars]. Define restriction composition, the scalar-tower isomorphism by uniqueness of the actual left adjoints, the coefficient-induced map by transposing the direct unit, and the degree-zero ordinary-scalar comparison by transposing the ordinary unit. For a constructible locally closed immersion $a:S\hookrightarrow X$ into a Noetherian scheme [def-weil-open-immersion], [def-weil-closed-immersion], take the exact support functor through its closure, with its single-complex realization [def-sfb-locally-closed-coefficient-extension], [lem-weil-pbc-condensed-open-closed-recollement]. SupportComparison records the inverse-image comparisons as the actual scalar mates [def-sfb-scalar-pullback-mate], a closed-support isomorphism equal to the actual closed counit mate [def-sfb-closed-scalar-map], the open-unit identity, and zero open restriction of the closed comparison, on full unbounded categories. This defines data and their normalization predicate; it asserts no existence of these isomorphisms. The canonical coefficient action and open-extension isomorphisms are those of [def-sfb-derived-open-immersion-shriek-iso]. The canonical coefficient action and open-extension isomorphisms are those of [def-sfb-derived-comap-upper-star-iso].
